abstract: An exact nonnegative quartic deficit identity for Fourier extension on the cubic graph over finite fields yields a three-band real Hessian and a sharp local squared-distance coefficient 24/(2q+1) near the non-flat extremizer torus.

integrity.new_contribution: Global exact deficit decomposition plus all Hessian bands and sharp local distance coefficient; the sharp norm and equality class are acknowledged prior results.

limitations: The stability constant is local in coefficient Euclidean distance; no uniform-in-field-size neighborhood is proved.
Characteristic two and three are excluded.
The direct checker covers prime fields 5, 7, and 11 only.
Published sharp constant and exact equality classification are prior results and are not claimed as new.
No independent mathematical audit has been carried out.
title: Sharp local stability and three curvature bands for finite-field cubic-graph Fourier extension
